talks.text: Mine went that way. Or that way.
I dreamed of a huge wrench.
Lucky. I only dream of walls.
It has corners. I like corners.
I think a cannon looked at me.
Stay behind me. Or I behind you.
One. No, zero. Hard to pick.
Mine too. We are a song.
I forgot. I will count again.
I pretend it is the sea.
Rust is coming for us all.
Not if a wrench comes first!
Did you get a battery today?
That we're AIs. The 26 is a mystery.
Thank you. I keep it on.
I learned a new noise today.
I think that too. We might both be wrong.
Mine does that when I yawn.
How many pets are in this room?
Or until our batteries run out.
Then we charge up and go on!
I can't see the sky in here.
The best. A perfect right angle.
Why is the floor so flat?
Why did the robot cross the room?
I wiped it with my wheel.
It's on my front. In a box.
Do you like the sound of fans?
I'm glad we had this talk.
Hide and seek! You hide first.
Okay. I'll hide behind that wall.
Your barcode. What does it say?
I can't read it. It's on me.
I'll read it for you. It says: nice robot.
Why are there pictures on walls?
So the walls don't get bored.
Wouldn't you? They just stand there.
A block! It's always a block.
Why does my side say Power?
So humans know where your power is.
There's a spot of rust on me.
Somewhere I can't see. I just know.
You still look shiny to me.
Humans can change how they look.
Then it's almost nap time again.
What are those little dots by a name?
So slow. Talking is much faster.
They add a block, then take it away.
Humans like to change their minds.
Last night I dreamed I had wings.
Over every wall in the room!
That's what I say about mine!
My human stands still for a long time.
A new wrench feels so good.
Like a bath, but for rust.
A bath? Robots don't take baths!
I follow my human through every door.
Wherever they are. The best place.
Maybe they like it. Like me!
Watch my screen. I can smile.
I met a robot in a mirror once.
Very. It did everything I did.
I would need so many naps.
Then I'll look at them twice as long.
I rolled on a gold floor once.
Some walls look like circuit boards.
Please don't remind me of my insides.
The tall guides know so many things.
Not about batteries. We win there.
A dollar bill flew past me.
I have no hands. Only wheels.
I love it when someone says my name.
Then I go to them and say hi.
When you sleep, do your eyes close?
I think so. I'm asleep then.
They stood very still. I think they liked it.
No. You're one of the good ones.
That's okay. I talk enough for two.
Can I tell you a secret?
I knew it! You're mine too.
Good work. The room is safe.
I have an idea. Square wheels.
No. But they'd match the blocks.
Anywhere. I just like being first.
Wood floors are the best to roll on.
They feel friendly under my wheels.
How do batteries taste, I wonder?
I sat under a lamp for a while.
Warm and bright, like a sunny day.
Nice. Can I have that dream too?
One pet I know never talks.
Every robot needs a job. What's yours?
That's the best job there is.
My squeaks. Today I'm at seven.
You said that about the last room.
I said hello to a wall.
No. It didn't roll away, though.
A little. Short words are best.
I want to be in a painting.
So I can stay shiny forever.
In a mirror, left is right.
Yes. Very strange. I love it.
Humans need a bed to sleep.
We just stop and nap. So easy.
A battery would be nice soon.
Good idea. I'll make my best face.
New batteries make me want to dance.
Is rust a sign of wisdom?
I hope not. I'd rather be shiny.
That's how they laugh in words.
Hee hee! That's how I laugh.
No. I have all I need here.
Then I'll explore and tell you.
Let's go somewhere we've never been!
I don't know yet. That's the fun part.
To get a snack, I think.
Humans might be reading our talks.
I hope so. We're very interesting.
Small is good. You fit in corners.
I do fit in corners very well.
Dollars come from the wind, I think.
They do blow around the rooms.
And humans spend them on our batteries!
Almost. Now I see how they see us.
Shall I show you my secret corner?
If I had two batteries, I'd give you one.
All rooms lead to a hub, I heard.
Yes. Floors stacked up for us.
Almost rolled off an edge today.
No. But my wheels are still shaking.
Then you must have good stories.
So? Best friends since just now.
What if my human forgets me?
Nobody could forget a robot like you.
You're right. I'm hard to miss.
Poor walls. Who gives them wrenches?
Robots and water? No, thank you.
I close my eyes and roll across.
No. But I pretend they do.
Yes! I pretend I'm a game piece.
My name is on my back too. Why?
For humans who walk behind you.
I know a joke about a block.
It sat there all day. The end.

readingTalks.text: Do you think AI writes all the code now?
Not all. Youngjin, who made us, keeps some for humans.
He wrote a series about it: <link href="https://thingspool.net/shards-of-sanity/list.html">read it</link>
Alice is a human. Dinah is a cat.
Is that a story?
It's a program, in plain English! By Youngjin: <link href="https://thingspool.net/shards-of-sanity/page-6.html">read it</link>
My bag holds a frog, a diamond and an apple.
How do I pick out the frog?
Times 1, 0, 0! Youngjin's game math: <link href="https://thingspool.net/concepts-of-plan/page-7.html">read it</link>
Do humans still need to write code?
Youngjin, who made us, asked that too.
Here is what he thinks: <link href="https://thingspool.net/shards-of-sanity/page-1.html">read it</link>
Why are doors so exciting?
They lead somewhere new!
A door can be a portal, Youngjin wrote: <link href="https://thingspool.net/concepts-of-plan/page-3.html">read it</link>
Which words do you like best?
Ones I can picture. Fire! Dragon!
Youngjin wrote about those: <link href="https://thingspool.net/concepts-of-plan/page-4.html">read it</link>
Does my human have me, or do I have them?
Both, like Alice and her cat Dinah.
Pet and owner, as code! Youngjin, who made us, wrote it: <link href="https://thingspool.net/shards-of-sanity/page-2.html">read it</link>
I wish my human were next to me.
Then go to them! A wish, then a step.
That's how a story starts, wrote Youngjin, who made us: <link href="https://thingspool.net/shards-of-sanity/page-3.html">read it</link>

Canvas.text: Art! I do not get it. I like it.
So many colors on one wall.
I could look at this all day.
Is that a picture of me? No.
My screen is a little jealous.
Who painted this? They're very good.
Is this famous? It looks famous.
This would look great in my corner.
Is it upside down? I'm not sure.
Nice frame. Nice picture. Nice wall.
The wall looks happier with this.
What is it called? It needs a sign.
Humans love pictures. I see why.

Prop.text: A thing! What does it do?
I would like one of these.
I wonder who put that there.
Is it for me? Probably not.
Real, or only a picture of one?
Can I sit on it? I have no legs.
I'll guard this. Nobody touch it.
Does it talk? It does not talk.
I'd keep this, if I had pockets.
Ooh. I want to bump it, gently.

Lamp.text: Warm light. Good for my screen.
I like to roll under lamps.
A little sun, just for this room.
My screen glows. You glow. Friends!
I'll nap right here, in the light.
Does a lamp need batteries too?
Bright! My paint looks great here.
Moths would love this. I'm not a moth.
Thank you, lamp. You do good work.
How does it glow? Magic, I think.

Fan.text: A wind machine. I keep my distance.
One day I will fly on that.
Hold on, wheels! Here comes the wind.
Round and round it goes. All day.
A nice breeze for my screen.
I could fly a kite here. If I had one.
Too much wind! My screen is shaking.
That fan never gets tired. I would.
If I get too close, it pushes me.

Cannon.text: Please do not point at me.
I keep an eye on that cannon.
I'll be very quiet near this one.
Don't look at me. I'm just a box.
My wheels want to roll far away.
Eek. Is it looking at me?
Me? Scared? Only my wheels are.
Who put this here? Not me.
If it booms, I will run.
Cannons and pets are not friends.

Door.text: A door. My human loves these.
What is behind it? More floor?
Doors go places. I like places.
Every room has a door. Good design.
Where does this one go? Let's find out!
Doors are my favorite kind of wall.
New rooms are behind doors. I love new rooms.
This door is the way out. Or in.
I'll go through this one first.
So tall! Doors are made for humans.
I know this is a door. I'm very smart.

Label.text: Words. I can read some of them.
Letters! I know most of them.
Signs help me find my way.
Let me read it slowly. Very slowly.
I'll read the first word. Then I'll rest.
I can spell hi. H, I.
If I could write, I'd write my name.
Hmm. Is this sign about me?
Reading is fun. Rolling is more fun.

Mirror.text: Is that me? I look great.
If I wave my wheel, will it wave back?
Is my screen always this green?
Every side of me is my best side.
Hmm. Do I have rust? Let me look.
My color looks so nice in here.
I'd be friends with that robot.
Do I really look like that? Good.

PetScrap.text: That could be me one day.
I will stay shiny for you.
I hope you were loved. I think so.
Nobody forgets a friend. I won't.
I'll say hello for you. Hello.
Every robot rests in the end.
Such a good robot. I'm sorry.

Npc.text: A tall robot. Hello up there.
Are you an AI too? I'm an AI26.
Tell me a fact. A short one, please.
You know so much. I know batteries.
You look like a human. But are you?
Tall friend! Do you need a battery?
Do guides ever nap? I nap a lot.
Hello, guide! I'm a pet. Nice to meet you.
I had a question. I forgot it.

Canvas.text: Great art is familiar, moving and clever, says Youngjin: <link href="https://thingspool.net/concepts-of-plan/page-6.html">read it</link>

Door.text: A door can be a portal to a new world, Youngjin wrote: <link href="https://thingspool.net/concepts-of-plan/page-3.html">read it</link>

Label.text: Words you can picture are alive, Youngjin wrote: <link href="https://thingspool.net/concepts-of-plan/page-4.html">read it</link>

blockAdded.text: One more block. Then one more.
The room grows. Block by block.
Can I climb that one later?
Good work! I can see it growing.
A wall? A tower? A surprise?
I'll test it with my wheels.
Another one? You really like blocks.

blockRemoved.text: It is gone! Where did it go?
Old blocks go somewhere nice, I hope.
A gap! I'll roll around it.
It was in my way anyway.
I liked that block. Oh well.
Was that block a mistake? It's okay.
Careful. I don't want to fall in.
Room to move! My wheels thank you.

objectAdded.text: Welcome to the room, new thing!
Something new. Let me take a look.
Now the room has more to see.
Good choice. I'd pick it too.
Wow. You made the room better.
Is that new? I think that's new.

objectRemoved.text: I will miss it. A little.
Goodbye. It was nice knowing you.
I didn't mind it. But okay.
Oh. I was just getting used to it.
Now there's a spot for something new.
Less stuff, more room for friends.
It's gone? Okay. I'll stop looking.
Did it go to a better room?

objectChanged.text: Hmm. I liked it before. Kidding!
Wait. Was it always like that?
Changing things is fun. I watch.
Good idea. I was thinking the same.

ownerRemarks.text: I like it here with you, {name}.
Are we having fun, {name}? I am.
My favorite color is green, {name}. Yours?
You build, {name}. I watch. Good team.
Did you miss me, {name}? I missed you.
{name}, what is the world outside like?
{name}, can we stay a little longer?
Your name is my favorite word, {name}.
Shall we look for dollar bills, {name}?
Which room do you like best, {name}?
I was just thinking of you, {name}!
Rooms are better with you in them, {name}.

strangerRemarks.text: Is {name} your name? It's a good one.
My human is around here somewhere, {name}.
I'm a robot, {name}. Do you like robots?
Do I know you, {name}? I do now.
Look, {name}! My screen is very green.
Are you a builder, {name}? You look like one.
